missing: A real overnight run: a named 5,000 BTU unit (ideally an inverter model) actually started and run 8 hours on a named 2-3 kWh station in a tent or camper, with measured duty cycle, Wh consumed, surge confirmed, and current prices for the two or three stations that make the night.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears. Four niche sites (testedwatts, homepowerfacts, outageoutfitter, outagemath) answer the 5,000 BTU question with spreadsheet runtimes from spec sheets, and they disagree by 2x on average draw (225 W vs 347 W vs 440 W) because none has measured anything; two more size for 8,000 BTU or a generic 720 W unit, and the rest are a brand blog, affiliate explainers and two blank pages. None addresses the tent/camper setting or names a tested overnight pairing. A page with a measured overnight test, a direct pick at each capacity tier and live prices would stand out.
